environment.description: Quarkus native-image Lambda deployed behind API Gateway (REST API type) with no throttling configured. Lambda provisioned concurrency set to 50 to eliminate cold-start jitter. PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance in same VPC with sub-millisecond latency. No rate limiting at any layer. API Gateway timeout set to 29s. CloudWatch metrics show consistent ~0.3ms response time variance, making timing measurements feasible with ~1000 samples per byte position.
